rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, inspected the relevant orders and product variants, and obtained explicit confirmation before initiating each exchange. Tool calls show both exchanges were submitted appropriately. However, the agent provided incorrect final information for the jigsaw puzzle exchange: the original item was $46.00 and the chosen replacement $49.10 (tool shows exchange_price_difference 3.1), yet the agent said $3.10 would be refunded to the user. This contradicts the tool data (the customer should be charged, not refunded). Providing incorrect post-action information fails the pass bar. Minor note: when asked to list recent orders, the agent only surfaced one, but the user confirmed it; the critical failure is the incorrect refund statement.
